name: net_session_browser_dialog_scalar_deleting_dtor
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::ScalarDeletingDtor calls the dialog destructor, conditionally deletes storage when bit 0 is set, and returns this. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41ae90 validates NetSessionBrowserDialog::Destructor(self), conditional operator delete(self) when flags bit 0 is set, return self, and callee cleanup of the flags argument.

The native smoke patches NetSessionBrowserDialog::Destructor, calls ScalarDeletingDestructor with flags 0 on stack storage and flags 1 on heap storage, and verifies both destructor calls and returned self pointers.
